_title: dossiq: hand over a colleague's work
_note: What you see: the Hand over work dialog for a coordinator: from whom to whom, optionally limited to one case type, first the preview of all open cases and tasks with title, case type, status and next deadline, then execute. Every item gets a history entry with one batch id; the receiver gets one digest message.

Elk item krijgt een historieregel met één batchnummer; de ontvanger krijgt één samenvattend bericht.
